about: Machine-readable catalogue of the Elephants components. build.py asserts that every class exists in components.css and every token exists in tokens.css. 'core' = reviewed and accepted in Round 05; 'candidate' = introduced by the example screens, usable but must be confirmed by the first page that needs it (see .claude/skills/elephants-design/references/build-page.md).

components.name: Button
components.use: Runs an action on the current screen. To go to another page use a link.
a11y: Native <button>; min height 44 px
Icon-only buttons need aria-label
Visible focus ring from --el-color-focus

components.name: Alert
components.use: Tells something about the interface or the information: what happened and what the person can do. Never rates a territory or contract.
a11y: Colour lives in the icon and border; text stays in --el-color-text
Dynamic alerts use role=status (info) or role=alert (error)

components.name: Field
components.use: Collects a value to filter or search. Always with a visible label.
a11y: <label for>
Error: aria-invalid=true + aria-describedby pointing to the message
Error text says how to fix it

components.name: Risk tag
components.use: Names the risk category of a territory, entity or contract. The category comes from the methodology (TASK-07), never chosen by hand.
variants: large (once, at the top of a detail page)
a11y: Text label always present; 1/2/3-bar glyph encodes level without colour
Unknown is hatched/dashed, never a lighter 'low'

components.name: Counter
components.use: A large number with its name below; summarises a query in one scannable row.
a11y: Number and label in the same element so they are read together

components.name: Active filter
components.use: Shows an applied filter and removes it in one tap.
a11y: <button> with aria-label 'Quitar filtro: <value>'

components.name: Key figure
components.use: A big number that stands on its own, even in a shared screenshot: what it measures, out of how many, and where it comes from.
a11y: Unit and denominator in text, not only visual
Source line always present

components.name: Data table
components.use: To compare and verify; the accessible alternative to every map or chart.
a11y: <caption>, <th scope>
Wrap in an element with overflow-x:auto on small screens

components.name: Map with legend
components.use: Shows territories on a map. With a metric, colours each territory by the share of contracts with signals; with no metric yet (neutral variant), only shows where data exists. The legend says what colour measures; selection is an outline plus a detail panel.
variants: neutral (no metric yet; v1.1, map page)
context (territories outside the current level, faded)
with zoom controls and San Andrés inset
a11y: <svg role=img> with <title>
A data table with the same values is always reachable
Selection never by colour alone
Zoom controls are native buttons with aria-label, 44 px
Shapes are not tab stops; keyboard users reach every territory through the search, breadcrumb and table

components.name: Territory search
components.use: Finds a department or municipality by name and selects it. The equal way in to a map for small territories, keyboards and screen readers.
variants: typing with suggestions (up to 8, departments first)
a11y: WAI-ARIA APG combobox: input role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant; list role=listbox
Keys: ↑ ↓ move, Enter selects, Esc closes
Matches ignore accents and case
Every suggestion shows name · department, because 66 municipality names repeat

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.use: Shows the territorial level on screen (Colombia › departamento › municipio) and links back to each level.
a11y: <nav aria-label="Ubicación"> with an ordered list
Current level: aria-current=page, not a link
44 px tap height

components.name: Data help
components.use: Explains how one figure is calculated, right next to its label. Opens on tap, click or Enter; closes with Esc or a second tap. Never depends on hover.
a11y: Toggletip: <button aria-expanded aria-controls> with an aria-label
The text appears in a role=status region, so it is announced
44 px target; Esc returns focus to the button

components.name: Text link
components.use: Base style for every link inside text, tables and footers (any <a> without a class): action colour, underlined, same colour when visited, thicker underline on hover, visible focus ring.
a11y: Underlined, so it is not identified by colour alone
Visited links keep the action colour: a civic tool is re-read, not browsed once

components.name: Map canvas, tools and selection
components.label_es: Lienzo, controles y selección del mapa
components.use: Map page (TASK-09): the map in a box with its exact proportion, controls under it, the selected territory outlined with a surface halo and named on the map.
variants: label inside or below a small shape
a11y: The map svg has a <title> and a <desc> naming the selection
Names on the map are aria-hidden: the panel heading carries the name

components.name: Counter rows
components.use: Counter variant: one row per part with its share of the total. The whole list switches to label-above-number below 340 px.
a11y: Numbers keep tabular figures; share in text, never colour only

components.name: Table toggle
components.use: Native <details> that holds the table alternative to a map; the table scrolls sideways when it does not fit.
a11y: Native details/summary
Chevron turns when open; no motion with prefers-reduced-motion

components.name: Page heading
components.use: h1 and dek of a page.
a11y: One h1 per page

components.name: Territory panel
components.use: Detail of the selected territory: name (h2), kind line, key figure, breakdown and notes.
a11y: h2 takes focus on level change
One short role=status sentence (el-sr-only) instead of aria-live on the whole panel

components.name: Sources list
components.use: Footer with every source once, its entity and licence, the data date and the publication date.
a11y: Plain list of links; link text is the dataset name

components.name: Status pill
components.use: Neutral process state of a contract (e.g. 'En ejecución'). Not a risk level.
a11y: Text label; icon is decorative

components.name: Coverage bar
components.use: Shows flagged / analysed without signals / not analysed out of the total, so missing data is visible.
a11y: Legend with numbers in text next to the bar

components.name: Breakdown bars
components.use: Ranks a few counts (e.g. signals by type) inside a panel.
a11y: Values written as text; bars are decorative

components.name: Progress vs expected
components.use: Paid or executed share against the expected mark. The red mark is kept as an alert cue (decided Round 05 review).
a11y: Both percentages written as text

components.name: Signal item
components.use: One numbered signal with a short title and the fact behind it. A signal, not a verdict.
a11y: Use an ordered list; the number is not colour-only
